record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: phase-gate-contract
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: R2 / suite-plugin-defaults — plugin/bundled default is mode=none (empty command); this repo alone pins mode=full + gate=advisory (R6).
    observed: contract/project-design.json ships phase_gate.suite as full+advisory. ensure-store copy gives consumers full+advisory. README claims consumer default mode=none. Live .artifacts/project-design.json has no phase_gate.
    severity: major
  - task: phase-gate-contract
    kind: missing-test
    expected: Contract self-consistency proves bundled design suite default is mode=none (separately from this-repo full+advisory).
    observed: test_phase_gate_suite_plugin_defaults only asserts a local constant; never reads bundled JSON. test_phase_gate_suite_this_repo_full_advisory locks contract to full+advisory so R2 cannot regress-fail.
    severity: major
  - task: phase-gate-contract
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: Sync live .artifacts/project-design.json with this-repo full+advisory (or separate consumer default from this-repo pin).
    observed: Phase diff only changes contract/project-design.json. Worktree .artifacts/project-design.json lacks phase_gate.
    severity: minor
integration:
  interfaces: phase_gate.suite in contract; affidavit/suite.py loads policy; execute-phase documents gates; dashboard suite chrome; README; tests extended.
  assumptions: Graded against R1-R8 and ensure-store cp contract→.artifacts consumer path.
  invariants: waiver/red-first/scoped verify hold in docs/tests; plugin default none vs this-repo full+advisory not separated in shipped design file.
  conflicts: R2/suite-plugin-defaults/README vs R6/contract contents/ensure-store copy; live store design unsynced with contract.
record.subject: verification-policy-review
